"hold on to your butts.." -Sam Jackson

2-9-24: 1.6 Update:
Ocean has been upgraded to 5.2 
Added Niagara Water Sim plug in / Tested with compile.
Added Melee Fight pack
Ships are back in the new Ocean system, added a few more Yachts
Fixed many Building Bugs.
Fixed a bunch of the Compile warnings to clean up the encoding.
Had to remove: //Weather is no longer attached to the ocean.

Personal note: So I started this project two years ago, Most people told me I was nuts to try this.
Stacking myself against the big AAA companies, to build a game that could be any game the players wanted.
However I did hit all my release dates, Early access and then release. 
I worked probably 14 -15 a day for the last two years to try to make this happen.
Now the DCF engine which is what runs CC is outstanding. 
CC laid on top of it was very close to breaking down tons of barriers, and offering players whole worlds to play in and modify as they choose.
The work of getting out to people (marketing) has always been my weak point. 
So this time I really lowered my expectations, I ran my lifestyle down to the bare minimum to try to get this thing to go.
But no one would play. I have given the game to hundreds of people,
Lifetime unique users (?)	127	
Median time played	13 minutes
---
I think it is pretty clear that CC will never get a chance. 
I want to thank those few people that did jump into the game and gave it a chance. But for the rest, Go play Palworld, and Skull and Bones.  You were never going to give me or CC a chance. 1.6 will be the last scheduled update, probably the last update to be honest.
The discord will remains up, but it is not a social spot. Get in ask a tech question and get answer and get out. 
I have no desire to see the community in CC anymore, or to help build it. 
My discord is to ask tech questions about the game,
Not make suggestions or offer feedback. I want neither.

Was able to fix the issue with the Continent Control Mens (admin menu) 

Menu got updated to the proper color sceme.
There is a new TerraForming Tut video on youtunbe now as well: 
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCG4oZ-CVsbnPzdAKxSAR8WA

Map now will load from the workshop correctly.
Grid Terrians were not tiliing correctly, fixed

notes.title: 1.5 Project "Jump The Unreal Shark"
notes.content:
On December 15th, a greatly awiated ocean update came out. However because CC was built in Unreal 5.0.3 the update was not available. 
In a moment of pure stupidity we decided to Update CC from Unreal 5.0.3 to 5.3.2
The whole Game has once again become more modular, and open to modifcation.

Look to see many patches bringing this version far beyond what we even thought was possible. 
Creative Continents has a wide open future with this version allow it to pivot to virtually canything the gamers, moddder, and Devolopments chooses. 

Creative Continents 
"Shape the worlds you play in"

notes.content:
Creative Continents 1.0

Voxel, 1.2+ beta Verison, that allows source compile.

Oceanolgy
Ultra Dynamic Sky/Weather

Many other asessts were used from the Epic marketplace, and CC thanks and acknowledges all of them for their help in creating This open world for players! 
Creative Continents is a Game that is built with the Idea of DCF (Digital Creative Freedom).
In essance trying to give the player every chocie the devoloper has.


Our Journey to that Freedom starts here....

.95 we are rounding the corner now to final Release. 
This version you will start to see the workshop map saving and sharing system coming in. (Should be fully working friday) 
Many other changes improvements and things, But remember it still early access some things are still in progress. 
We hope you enjoy, and stop by the discord to give you thougts and ideas.

notes.title: One year later, the Full realease. .9 verison
notes.content:
.9 is here.
This is very close to the final version. But not the final vision of the game.
This version does finally open up and show the many things that you and your friends will be able to do on your custom Continents (maps). 
Map Sharing through Steam workshop will also be implamented soon. All in All I am on track to realease the final 1.0 at he end Of November.   
This last base has been built around being open to modding and Steam Commiunty, with this I hope people will be able to start to see the CC will allow you Play and Create in it, at whatever level you want to particpate. Player, Modder, Devloper, its all the ame path on the Continents. 
Come on by and make some lands before December. Be the first to show off your own world. :D

notes.title: Stage 2.1
notes.content:
Ready Player me is WORKING! ITS WORKING!!!!!
Now You can create the Map you want and then visit your lands with your friends, and now you will be able to be whoever you like as well thanks to RPM. 

Update to Phase II .1:
Rpm Update: Ready Player Me is now fully working with the system. I have noticed a issue when the character is killed and respawned. So I will take a look into that as well. 
Next Project: I will be jumping full bore into the map issue. 
Check out our discord to join the community.
New Issues:
Inventory (backpacks)

Creative Continent Phase 2 Read Me:
***Map Issue*** 
The Main issue the game faces right now is that the map you customize for your guest in Multiplayer.
However there is a work around. In your game folder go to CC\Saved\SaveGames
You will see a file named Continent.sav
If you and your Visitors all have the same Continent.sav file It will play without problem.

I am working hard to resolve this issue so that map files will be moved and shared inside the game engine.


***Map Save/Load Issue: In Creation Mode: sometimes when saving and loading it will crash the game engine. 
I suggest you save to edit first thus saving changes you have made to the landscape. 

***Ready Player Me: I have been very actively engaged in adding RPM and it is very close to going live into the CC engine. 
This will all players to play their own custom character. (resolved .1)


The Story So Far: 
I was frustrated Playing games because of their creative Limits. I decided to try and build my own. Creative Continents, is that Journey.
